label: Group
description: Lanthanides and actinides are listed as group 3.

label: Orbital quantum number l
description: 0 = s, 1 = p, 2 = d, 3 = f block.

label: Metal / metalloid / nonmetal
description: 1 = metal, 2 = metalloid, 3 = nonmetal.

label: Mendeleev number
description: Pettifor-style chemical scale used for structure maps.

label: Family (lab grouping)
description: 1 alkali, 2 alkaline earth, 3 Sc/Y/lanthanides/actinides, 4 transition metals, 5 post-transition metals, 6 metalloids, 7 nonmetals, 8 halogens.

label: Electron affinity
description: Negative values: the anion is unbound.

label: Ghosh electronegativity
description: Rises steeply across the 5d row, hence the log scale.

label: Miracle radius
description: Radii for metallic glasses (Miracle et al.).

label: Electrical resistivity
description: Header says mΩ, but the values are in Ω·m (Ag = 1.6e-8).

label: LDA total energy
description: Free-atom total energy in the LDA approximation.

label: LDA kinetic energy
description: Free-atom kinetic energy in the LDA approximation.

label: LDA electron–electron energy
description: Free-atom electron–electron energy in the LDA approximation.

label: LDA electron–nucleus energy
description: Free-atom electron–nucleus energy in the LDA approximation.

label: LDA exchange–correlation energy
description: Free-atom exchange–correlation energy in the LDA approximation.

label: LSD total energy
description: Free-atom total energy in the spin-polarized LSD approximation.

label: LSD kinetic energy
description: Free-atom kinetic energy in the spin-polarized LSD approximation.

label: LSD electron–electron energy
description: Free-atom electron–electron energy in the spin-polarized LSD approximation.

label: LSD electron–nucleus energy
description: Free-atom electron–nucleus energy in the spin-polarized LSD approximation.

label: LSD exchange–correlation energy
description: Free-atom exchange–correlation energy in the spin-polarized LSD approximation.

label: RLDA total energy
description: Free-atom total energy in the relativistic RLDA approximation.

label: RLDA kinetic energy
description: Free-atom kinetic energy in the relativistic RLDA approximation.

label: RLDA electron–electron energy
description: Free-atom electron–electron energy in the relativistic RLDA approximation.

label: RLDA electron–nucleus energy
description: Free-atom electron–nucleus energy in the relativistic RLDA approximation.

label: RLDA exchange–correlation energy
description: Free-atom exchange–correlation energy in the relativistic RLDA approximation.

label: ScRLDA total energy
description: Free-atom total energy in the scalar-relativistic ScRLDA approximation.

label: ScRLDA kinetic energy
description: Free-atom kinetic energy in the scalar-relativistic ScRLDA approximation.

label: ScRLDA electron–electron energy
description: Free-atom electron–electron energy in the scalar-relativistic ScRLDA approximation.

label: ScRLDA electron–nucleus energy
description: Free-atom electron–nucleus energy in the scalar-relativistic ScRLDA approximation.

label: ScRLDA exchange–correlation energy
description: Free-atom exchange–correlation energy in the scalar-relativistic ScRLDA approximation.

label: Thermal neutron capture cross-section
description: How strongly the element swallows slow neutrons. Gd is the champion.
